description: Implementation of a scheduler service using Java's Timer, managing scheduled tasks in the OpenMRS platform. It handles task scheduling, shutdown, rescheduling, and persistence with a focus on timer-based task execution within the OpenMRS ecosystem.

classes.name: TimerSchedulerServiceImpl
classes.description: Implements a scheduler service using Java Timer, managing creation, scheduling, rescheduling, and shutdown of tasks within the OpenMRS platform.

methods.name: onStartup
methods.description: Initializes the scheduler by loading existing tasks from the database and scheduling them if configured to start on startup.

methods.name: onShutdown
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down the scheduler, canceling all timers and tasks.

methods.name: scheduleTask
methods.description: Schedules a task based on its task definition, setting start times, intervals, and adding it to the scheduled tasks map.

methods.name: shutdownTask
methods.description: Stops a specific task, removing it from schedules and updating its status.

methods.name: rescheduleTask
methods.description: Reschedules an existing task by shutting it down and scheduling anew.

methods.name: saveTaskDefinition
methods.description: Persists a task definition to the database, creating or updating as needed.
